_help: Tuff SMP zones. Put this file AND zones_mask.png in config/shrinecraft/, then /tuffsmp gui reload. 'map' = the zone picture drawn from the owner's borders: center_pixel is the arrow (world 'center'), blocks_per_pixel = world blocks per picture pixel (circle radius 2500 blocks = 440 map px, 2 map px per picture pixel). inner_radius = the hub with NO gui (150 is a guess: change it).
